# Import data

```{r}
for (.f in list.files("_targets/objects/")) {
  tar_load(.f)
}
```


```{r}
str(CCR_stats_3_2)
```



```{r}
stats <- list(data.table(data.frame(min_genes = 3, min_width = 2, rbindlist(CCR_stats$`3_2`))), 
     data.table(data.frame(min_genes = 50, min_width = 3, rbindlist(CCR_stats$`50_2`)))) |>
  rbindlist()

stats[, perc_changed := (changed/not_changed)*100]

stats |> 
  ggplot(aes(min_ngenes)) + 
  geom_boxplot(aes(y = perc_changed))

```

# Observation on duplicated Chr15 region

- ~330 gene duplicated region of `chr19` on the `chr15 p-arm`, 30 megabases (Mb), at 60-90 Mbp
- specifically from position 61,105,000 to 89,890,000 on chromosome 15.


```{r}

list.files("plots", full.names = T) |> knitr::include_graphics()
```
